messages:
Alex (CEO): short exec update for the week: three asks + one policy tweak. TL;DR: ship Private GA pilots, accelerate unit-cost work, and shorten default log retention for new orgs. :rocket:

Alex (CEO): priority 1) Private GA: complete compliance checklist + onboard pilot customers by Wed EOD. @Jordan confirm pilot roster.
Alex (CEO): priority 2) Cost: aim for additional -12% unit cost by Friday via batching and pruning cold models (currently -8%).
Alex (CEO): priority 3) Reliability: target SLO 99.95% for inference p50/p95. Note: small spike yesterday 03:12 UTC caused by KV cache eviction; patch inbound.

Alex (CEO): policy note: default hosted-log retention for new orgs will change 90->30 days starting next Tue; existing customers unchanged unless they opt-in. cc @Priya

Jordan - VP Product: will lock pilot list by tomorrow AM. Q: should we deprioritize non-core features to free eng time?

Sam (VP Eng): can replan. Canary for private-ga is green on 2/3 clusters; cluster-c failing due to GC config and OOM in KV rebuild. Rollback path ready. Hotfix for KV eviction queued.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary report private-ga/v1.4 -> cluster-a: ✅, cluster-b: ✅, cluster-c: ❌ (OOM during KV rebuild). logs: https://ci.internal/reports/4766

Marie - Head of Ops: Dedicated pools at 5% buffer. If pilots scale quickly we should pre-warm one node group. @Sam please action.

Sam (VP Eng): will pre-warm 2 g4dn groups by 12:00 UTC. Hotfix landing in ~10m.

Taylor (CFO): approving short-term infra spend for pre-warm. To reach -12% we also need L7 quantization on low-priority models.

Priya (People Ops): hiring freeze for non-critical IC reqs this quarter; exceptions require VP sign-off. Scheduling two exec recruiter screens next week.

Alex (CEO): request: each VP post a 1-line status here by EOD Thu with a measurable next step.

Sam (VP Eng): 1-liner: KV eviction hotfix merged; pre-warm + fix should clear cluster-c by 12:30 UTC.

Marie - Head of Ops: 1-liner: pre-warm scheduled; dashboards updated; ops runbook v2 published.

Taylor (CFO): 1-liner: pre-warm spend approved; tracking in weekly finance deck.

Priya (People Ops): 1-liner: hiring hold in effect; exceptions process circulated.

Sam (VP Eng): rollback command if needed:
```
./deploy rollback private-ga --to v1.3 --clusters cluster-c
```

Alex (CEO): thanks all — small morale ask: shout out to pilots team if you see them. :clap:
